chunks: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم looked at a man with a long beard and said: “How good this would have been, had he arranged some of his beard.”
That reached the man, so he arranged his beard to a moderate extent. Then he came to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, and when he saw him, he said: “Do like this.”

key_terms.النَّبِيِّ: The Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: The Messenger of Allah, referring to the Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.فَافْعَلُوا: So do; an instruction to follow this practice
key_terms.هَيَّأَ: He arranged, groomed, or put in proper order

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith teach about trimming and grooming the beard in the sunnah?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم encouraging neatness and moderation in personal appearance. It presents grooming the beard properly as part of good etiquette and refinement in accordance with the Prophetic sunnah.
